answer: One-time answer gate. Each new identity must submit an answer to a challenge seeded by a live zephyr measurement and a registry nonce; the verifier rejects any duplicate answer hash or expired challenge. A bridge maps challenge IDs to accepted answers, so copying a solved reply fails. Agents can wander across hosts, but every identity costs one fresh CPU-minute plus a signed timing trace, making bulk sybils scale linearly with attacker compute.
